title: Booking a library study room that is already taken

setting.situation: A student writes to the library chat on Tuesday asking for a group study room for four people on Thursday from 2 to 4 pm. Every group room is booked for that slot.

participant.brief: The booking system shows a free group room on Thursday from 4 to 6 pm and a two-person booth at 2 pm. There is a waiting list for cancellations. Rooms can only be booked for the current week.

counterpart.name: Mert Yıldız
counterpart.background: Has a group presentation on Friday morning and has never used the room booking system before.

objective: End the chat with a room the group can use, or with the student on the waiting list and knowing how it works.
opening_message: hi, can i book a group room for thursday 2-4? there are 4 of us

key_moments.description: Telling the student the 2 to 4 slot is full.
Which of the later room, the booth or the waiting list comes up, and in what order.
What has actually been booked when the chat ends.
